<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Posts shown off. Axes: layout (intro: four small post cards beside the intro with a view-all link, featured:
  the first post in detail beside its picture, overlay: cards with the text over the picture), cols (2, 3:
  overlay columns), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Post, PostLabels } from "./post-card.types";
import type { HeadLink } from "../components/section-frame.types";

export type PostShowcaseProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  badge?: string;
  posts: Post[];
  labels: PostLabels;
  action: HeadLink;
  layout?: "intro" | "featured" | "overlay";
  cols?: "2" | "3";
  mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  empty?: string;
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Link from "../compose/Link.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import PostFeature from "../components/post-feature.vue";
import PostMiniCard from "../components/post-mini-card.vue";
import PostOverlayCard from "../components/post-overlay-card.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  badge = "",
  posts,
  labels,
  action,
  layout = "intro",
  cols = "3",
  mediaSide = "start",
  tone = "default",
  empty = "",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<PostShowcaseProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame v-if="((posts?.length ?? 0) === 0)"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <EmptyState icon="newspaper" :title="empty" />
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-else-if="((layout as string) === 'intro')"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true, side: mediaSide }"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Link :href="urlOf(action.href)" size="sm" data-testid="section-action">
      {{ action.label }}
      <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" :size="16" />
    </Link>
    <template #aside>
      <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <template v-for="(p, i) in posts" :key="p.id">
          <PostMiniCard v-if="(i < 4)" :p="p" :labels="labels" />
        </template>
      </Box>
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-else-if="((layout as string) === 'featured')"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true, side: mediaSide }"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <template v-for="(p, i) in posts" :key="p.id">
      <PostFeature v-if="(i < 1)" :p="p" :labels="labels" />
    </template>
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="4/3" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-else
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Box
      :class="
        (cols as string) === '2' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2'
        : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-3'
      "
    >
      <template v-for="(p, i) in posts" :key="p.id">
        <PostOverlayCard
          v-if="(i < (((cols as string) === '2') ? 2 : 3))"
          :p="p"
          :labels="labels"
          :ratio="(((cols as string) === '2') ? '16/9' : '4/3')"
        />
      </template>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
